name: Imprinted Duckling
text: When you play this card, convert it to the suit led.
archetypes: High Card, Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus; splash Discard Dominance
decision: Whether to save this card for a suit you're void in, where it joins the suit led and can win the trick instead of being thrown off.
opponent: Each conversion is shown; opponents see the engraved card join your trump or flooded suit and can lead to pull it.
aiNote: When void in the suit led, play this card if its rank beats the cards already played.
rationale: Once you're void, this card plays as the suit led, so a high card in a short suit wins a trick it would otherwise throw away, about a third of a trick a round. Following suit or leading leaves it unchanged, so the only decision is when to hold it for a void.
deviation: Simplified from converting this card whenever you played another card off suit, which was hard to follow.
